body: Although 0:03.100 is wrong, `DatePipe` should be used to display date, not time intervals and in my opinion it should not be rounded. For example, `2018-06-08T23:59:59.999` should not be rounded to `2018-06-09T00:00:00.00` in any circumstance.
I agree with both comments above.
